Where: Cli CaO = Monthly total CaO content of Clinker, wt-fraction. Cli ncCaO = Monthly non-calcined CaO content of Clinker, wt-fraction. MR CaO = Molecular-weight Ratio of CO 2 /CaO = 0.785.
